name: @w6w-apps/cloudbeds
description: Manage reservations, guests, room types, rates and properties on the Cloudbeds hotel/property-management platform.

w6w.longDescription:
Cloudbeds is a hotel and property-management platform: the system a property runs its front desk, reservations, rates and guest records on. This app covers the core of the PMS API v1.3 that a workflow actually needs — searching and creating reservations, checking room-type availability and rate plans for a date range, reading and updating guest records, and reading a property's own details and daily dashboard.

Two vendor quirks shape the client rather than being left as surprises: some failures answer HTTP 200 with `{success: false, message}` instead of a 4xx, and the real API base and OAuth authorize/token URLs differ from what a quick guess would produce. Health checks track Cloudbeds' own status page, scoped to the one component ("Property Management System") this app's actions actually depend on, so an unrelated marketing-connector incident elsewhere on the page never drags this app's health down with it.

The full Cloudbeds surface is far larger than this app covers — allotment blocks, payments and items, housekeeping, webhooks, accounting/fiscal documents, the Insights datasets API, and the channel-manager callback operations are all out of scope for this first pass. See the README for what's not yet covered.
